VAL-TASK4-001.description: Task Zero flag in AppDelegate - ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP allows session bootstrap while blocking task_start
VAL-TASK4-001.evidence: ISHRuntimeFlags.h defines ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP 1. TerminalViewController.m startSession checks this flag after do_execve and before task_start(current), returning 0 without starting guest when flag is set.

VAL-TASK4-002.description: Removed debug junk - AppDelegate returns success cleanly
VAL-TASK4-002.evidence: AppDelegate.m boot() checks ISH_TASK_ZERO_DISABLE_EMULATION at entry and returns 0 immediately when set. No file-based boot logs, /tmp write tests, giant NSLog probes, or ELF forensics present in boot path. Records session.bootstrap.deferred event via ISHInstrumentation.

VAL-TASK4-003.description: Terminal UI loads - allows session bootstrap without guest execution
VAL-TASK4-003.evidence: TerminalViewController.m startSession allows become_new_init_child, PTY creation, create_stdio, and do_execve, but blocks task_start when ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP is 1. UI loads and app remains alive without guest execution.
